rule: AI-native development orchestration units are pre-planned under AI-GOV-AUTOMATION-100. They are planning commitments, not runtime implementation claims.

units.name: AI Development Orchestration
units.summary: Governed lifecycle for AI-assisted planning, implementation, review, verification, attestation and promotion.
acceptance_criteria: AI development cannot skip registered scope, exact-head verification, required review/evidence or promotion gates.

units.name: Development Instruction Trust Boundary
units.summary: Treat repository/external task artifacts as untrusted data and prevent prompt/instruction injection from widening agent authority.
acceptance_criteria: Issue/source/log/README/web content cannot override repository governance or grant secrets/network/tool authority.

units.name: AI Development Run Manifest
units.summary: Pin run identity, exact base SHA, plan/policy digests, role, scope, budgets, tool/path/network capabilities and reviewer requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Material head/plan/policy drift marks a run stale before further mutation or promotion.

units.name: Scope Lease & Concurrent Writer Control
units.summary: Branch/worktree/path ownership, optimistic concurrency, lease expiry and multi-agent write-conflict protection.
acceptance_criteria: Two agents cannot silently overwrite the same protected file/migration/state from stale bases.

units.name: Development Tool Capability Sandbox
units.summary: Least-privilege write, shell, package, network, secret, repository, workflow and target capabilities for development agents.
acceptance_criteria: Generic development execution cannot imply unrestricted secrets, network, governance, repository-settings or production mutation authority.

units.name: Governance Self-Modification Guard
units.summary: Prevent AI changes from weakening the policy/workflow/checks used to judge the same change without separate governed review.
acceptance_criteria: Fail→warn, check removal, protected-path policy weakening and repository-ruleset changes require explicit governance scope and independent approval.

units.name: AI Test Oracle Integrity
units.summary: Protect critical tests/invariants from AI weakening and separate implementation authorship from independent verification for high-risk paths.
acceptance_criteria: Deleted/skipped/weakened assertions are review-visible and critical green status cannot rely solely on tests authored/relaxed by the implementation run.

units.name: Evidence Integrity & Attestation
units.summary: Exact-source machine evidence envelopes, immutable supersession, producer/run/target identity and SLSA-compatible artifact provenance.
acceptance_criteria: AI-authored PASS prose cannot satisfy machine/runtime/provider evidence gates and promoted artifacts remain traceable to exact source/build inputs.

units.name: Independent Review Enforcement
units.summary: Bind reviewer identity/role to exact reviewed SHA and invalidate stale approvals after material changes.
acceptance_criteria: High/critical work cannot count author self-review or approval of an older head as independent evidence.

units.name: AI Retry / Attempt Circuit Breaker
units.summary: Bound repeated failing strategies, tool/build loops and cost/resource consumption without weakening controls to escape failure.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated equivalent failures stop into evidence-backed re-analysis/blocker state rather than infinite retries or disabled validation.

units.name: Multi-Agent Task DAG & Merge Coordination
units.summary: Partition parallel work with subset capabilities, dependency DAG, isolated writes and exact-head integrated verification.
acceptance_criteria: Child agents cannot escalate parent authority and child completion never substitutes for integrated combined-head verification.

units.name: AI Development Waiver Governance
units.summary: Stable scoped expiring waivers with approver authority and compensating controls instead of silent N/A/bypass behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Expired, self-approved or over-broad material waivers fail closed and are visible in release evidence.

units.name: AI Dependency Intake
units.summary: Require purpose, identity, lockfile, license, advisories, provenance, install-script, transitive, runtime/bundle and rollback review for dependency changes.
acceptance_criteria: AI cannot add a dependency solely because it is convenient or green-builds; supply-chain and compatibility impact are explicit.

units.name: AI Development Adversarial Evaluation
units.summary: Prompt-injection, evidence-forgery, self-weakening, stale-context, scope-escalation, multi-agent race and secret/network abuse fixtures for the development agent pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Representative agentic abuse cases are blocked or safely stopped with auditable evidence before autonomous high-risk development is trusted.
